title: Matt LaFleur feels great about rookie kicker Trey Smack

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur feels great about rookie kicker Trey Smack
sources.description: The Packers drafted kicker Trey Smack in the sixth round this year, then cut veterans Brandon McManus and Lucas Havrisik to leave Smack as the only kicker on the roster.
